import sys

def max_teams(n, groups):
    count_ones = groups.count(1)
    count_twos = groups.count(2)
    
    # Each team of three can be formed by:
    # - One group of two and one group of one
    # - Three groups of one
    
    # Calculate the maximum number of teams
    teams_from_two_and_one = min(count_twos, count_ones)
    remaining_ones = count_ones - teams_from_two_and_one
    teams_from_three_ones = remaining_ones // 3
    
    total_teams = teams_from_two_and_one + teams_from_three_ones
    return total_teams
